texts.zh:
啊哈！一位来访者。欢迎欢迎。

我们是[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]。在这个自虚空诞生的舱室里，我们的女巫集会谈论着凡人所费解的力量。我们思索着潜藏梦境中的秘密、探寻着原始灵能的贮藏地、凝视着驱动整个文明的无形齿轮……虚境对于聆听者，揭示良多。

此时此刻，我聆听于你。什么风把你吹来了？你已知否？
texts.en:
Ah! A visitor. Welcome.

We are the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]. Within this void-borne hull, our coven communes with forces incomprehensible to most mortal minds. We contemplate the secrets that lie hidden in dreams, reservoirs of untapped potential, the unseen gears driving whole civilizations... The Shroud reveals much to those who would listen.

At this moment, I listen to you. What brings you to us? Do you yet know?

texts.zh:
啊哈，是不可知世界的旅伴！我们[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]欢迎你并视你为朋友。

请原谅这种低劣的沟通方式。我们所践行的强烈的灵能祷告，恐怕只能基于可畏的心灵感应屏障和通路而施行。因此，我们只能从物质世界中接收思想之一瞥。

所以我不禁要问：是什么风把你吹来的?
texts.en:
Ah, fellow sojourners of the unknowable! We, the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] welcome you and name you friends.

Please forgive this inferior means of communication. The intense, psionic devotions we practise may only be conducted from behind fearsome telepathic barriers and conduits. Thus, we may only receive glimpses of thought from the corporeal realm.

So it is that I must ask: what brings you to us?

texts.zh: 欢迎回来，来访者。我们等候多时。
texts.en: Welcome back, visitor. We have been waiting.

texts.zh: 许多文明都讲述着同样的故事，在过于幽深的矿洞里潜伏着黑暗的存在。那么来访者，请问你是否好奇过，在我们层层的现实之下隐藏着什么?
texts.en: So many civilizations tell the same kind of story, of dark things lurking in mines dug too deep. Tell me, visitor: have you ever wondered what lurks beneath the stratified layers of our reality?

texts.zh:
我们都知道一句谚语:
“被风吹进来的东西终将被雨冲出去。”
对于许多居住在短命行星上的居民来说，算是慰藉之辞……

在被我们称为虚境的世界里，可没有这样的天气。
texts.en:
There is a saying known to us:
"What is blown in by the wind will be washed out by the rain."
Comforting words for many a short-lived planet-dweller...

The realm we call the Shroud knows no such weather.

texts.zh: 那么，我们的旅伴回来了！很高兴再次看到你。我们等候多时。
texts.en: So, the sojourners return! It is pleasant to see you again. We have been waiting.

texts.zh:
在我们[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]坚持的所有信条中，少有比这一条更坚定的：即使地位崇高如我们一般，也肯定能在星海中找到同伴。

那么，我飞升了的朋友：我们能为彼此做些什么？
texts.en:
Of all the tenets we hold to in the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName], few are held more dearly than this: even those as elevated as ourselves can be sure of finding our fellows in the galaxy.

So, fellow ascendent one: how may we serve each other?

texts.zh: 闯入者，你的敌意就像恶臭的瘴气一样笼罩着自己。我们是和平的集会，但你要知道：如果你想让我们遭受苦难，你会发现这种愚蠢的行径将以十倍奉还。我们是[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]，尽管我们看似鞭长莫及，但我们的愤怒将会毁天灭地。
texts.en: Interloper, your hostility precedes you like a foul miasma. We are a peaceful coven, but know this: if you intend to inflict harm upon us, you shall find such folly visited back upon you tenfold. We are the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName], and though our reach may appear lacking, our wrath is devastating.

texts.zh:
你可真是名过其实。

我们拒绝与畏惧虚境之人共商大计。你们对宇宙的狭隘认知终将令我们所有人固步自封。
texts.en:
Your reputation precedes you.

We shall hold no counsel with those who fear the Shroud. Your limited vision of the cosmos will chain us all to the ground.

texts.zh:
[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的无知偏见毒害了你的思想。多么讽刺啊……

我们绝不会与和那些蠢货有染的人共商前途。
texts.en:
The ignorant prejudices of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] have poisoned your mind. What irony...

We will hold no counsel with those who hold such ties with fools.

texts.zh:
“你唤醒了远超你理解的恐怖，它宣告了星系的末日。

我们不愿去面对这样的疯狂事物。离我们远点！”
texts.en:
"You have awoken horror far beyond your understanding, and with it have doomed this galaxy.

We are unwilling to court madness itself. Be gone from us!"

texts.zh:
在这件事上我们已经竭尽全力。已经没有我们能帮你们引荐的实体了。

我们赞许你们的努力……很少有人灵潜至虚境如此深层的灵域还能保持心智如此健全。
texts.en:
We have reached the limits of our abilities to assist you in this regard. There are no further entities we are capable of guiding your thoughts to.

We commend you for your efforts... few delve so deeply into the domains of the Shroud and retain such soundness of mind.

texts.zh:
对没有准备的人而言，在虚境的灵域交流十分凶险。

我们可以引导你们完成这个过程，但是要注意：有些居住在里面的实体如果迎接入人的意识里是非常危险的。
texts.en:
Communing in the domains of the Shroud has proven to be a perilous endeavor for the unprepared.

We can guide you through this process, though take heed: The entities that dwell within can be very dangerous to welcome into one's mind.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
我们可以用一些泽珞来支持这项行动。
label.en: We can support this endeavor with Zro.

label.zh: 我我们可以用一些星界丝缕来支持这项行动。
label.en: We can support this endeavor with Astral Threads.

label.zh: 再会了。

texts.zh:
你们与虚境的意志调和得越深，你们的心智就会变得越强大。

你们想要和哪一位实体增进调和度呢？
texts.en:
The more deeply you attune to the Shroud's will, the more powerful your mind will become.

With which entity do you seek to further your attunement with?

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
世界之喰煞
魂灵之月窠
渴求之器具
生命之织缕
虚空之低语
再会了。

texts.zh:
噢，没错……虚境，它蕴藏着无数秘密，深深埋藏在思绪与梦境的帷幕之下——只要懂得如何去探寻，就能发现它们。

我们只能引领你去接触我们已揭示的洞见。在那里，或许能见到全新而强大的技术不断绽放，但长路漫漫，你仍需前进。

只需记住这一点：我们的灵能巫必须全身心投入这项领航的任务。而对于他们指引之外的事物……就不是我们所能掌控的了。
texts.en:
Oh yes... the Shroud It is teeming with secrets, layered deep beneath veils of thought and dream - if one knows how to seek them.

We can only guide you to the insights we have uncovered. From there, new and formidable technologies may bloom, but the path is yours to walk.

Just know this: our coven of telepaths must devote themselves wholly to this task. What lies beyond their guidance... is not ours to control.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
我们可以用一些泽珞来支持这项行动。
label.en: We can support this endeavor with Zro.

label.zh: 我我们可以用一些星界丝缕来支持这项行动。
label.en: We can support this endeavor with Astral Threads.

label.zh: 再会了。

texts.zh: [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]做好了灵潜仪式的一切必要准备工作，随时可以代我们进入虚境。他们能为我们寻得何种洞见仍不得而知。
texts.en: The [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] have made the necessary preparations to perform a Delving Ritual and reach into the Shroud on our behalf. Whatever insights they will guide us to are uncertain.

texts.zh:
随着冲突越来越近，我们冒着激怒祂们的风险徘徊着。

清晰聚焦后，我们就能让自己适应灵能瀑布，思想也会变得流畅。轰炸并没有减弱，但我们却毫发无损，反而是随着毁灭的节奏和谐地移动着。

每进一步，我们的理解力就会增长。灵能的弹幕在不可见的位面之间滑移。

我们退出时，这种模式仍然存在。经过改进，我们所观察到的这些原理就可以用在我们的武备上。
texts.en:
We linger, risking wrath as the conflict draws ever closer.

With clear focus, we attune ourselves to the psychic cascade, our thoughts fluid. The bombardment does not relent, yet we remain untouched, moving in harmony with the rhythm of destruction.

With each step, our comprehension grows. The psionic barrage is slipping between gaps in unseen planes.

As we withdraw, the pattern remains. With refinements, the principles we observed could be adapted for our own ordnance.

label.zh: 离开虚境。

texts.zh:
压力越来越大，期望在逗弄着我们。我们随着之上涌，让思想穿过这座精神迷宫。思绪变成了驱策着我们前进的动量。趁我们在决心动摇之前穿梭在灵能的能量弧之间。

我们无拘无束，超越了物质形态。迷宫和其内的无数道路成为我们意识的延伸，找到了深藏在这场模式的风暴中的知识。

这一刻开始得很快，结束得也很快。我们再次带着新寻见的理解涌现，而迷宫的残影也在身后陡然崩塌。这些灵能原理经过仔细的改进后就可以应用到我们的武器上。
texts.en:
The pressure builds, teasing us with expectation. We move at its crescendo, willing our minds through the labyrinth of psychic energy. Thoughts become momentum, urging us forward. slipping between the arcs of psionic energy before our resolve can falter.

We are untethered, ascendant beyond our physical forms. The maze and its multitude of pathways become an extension of our own consciousness, revealing hidden knowledge deep within the patterns of the storm.

As swiftly as it began, the moment is over. The afterimage of the labyrinth collapses behind us as we emerge with newfound understanding. With careful refinements, these psionic principles could be applied to our weapons of war.

label.zh: 离开虚境。

texts.zh:
完美成型的灵能能量束耀眼刺目，但我们还是尽全力将注意力聚焦其上。终于，我们看清了它错综复杂、超凡脱俗的结构的真相。

我们的脑海中奔腾着新的可能性；将这种独特的能量形式在物质世界复现，我们就会得到一种无可抵挡的武器。
texts.en:
Despite its blinding intensity, we managed to hold our focus on the perfectly formed beam of psychic energy. Finally, we beheld the true nature of its intricate and otherworldly structure.

Our minds raced with new possibilities; reproducing this unique energy formation in the physical realm will grant us an unstoppable weapon.

label.zh: 离开虚境。

texts.zh:
针对这种持续的轰炸，我们增强了心智，于是很快就弄明白了原因。

这种爆炸性惊厥是由我们自身所处维度的高浓度灵能能量反射流造成。这一连串危险的精神小泡有可能严重损害没有准备的人的心智。

从中得到了一个洞见：这种强有力的构造可以为从虚境中产出新武器提供基础。
texts.en:
We fortified our minds against this continued barrage and soon understood its nature.

The explosive convulsions are caused by currents of concentrated psionic energy reflected from our own dimension. These volatile beads of psychic intent have the potential to significantly damage the minds of the unprepared.

An insight took hold: these powerful formations will provide the basis for new weaponries borne from the Shroud.

label.zh: 离开虚境。

texts.zh:
虚境再一次证明了世上一切本就命定。

我们的密会本要为你们寻求的洞见已经被你自己通过钻研努力发现了。你们的努力值得赞赏，而我们在这个方面也没有什么能帮助你们的了。
texts.en:
The Shroud proves once again that there are no coincidences.

The insight our conclave sought for you has been discovered through your own delving efforts. While we applaud your efforts, we cannot help you further in this regard.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
再会了。

texts.zh:
称赞你们。你们对灵能光环的认知已经超越了我们。

你们的存在将虚境中的一种强大的肌理显化到我们的现实中。你们肯定知道着什么秘密……
texts.en:
We commend you. Your knowledge of Psionic Auras already surpasses our own.

Your very presence manifests a formidable texture of the Shroud into this reality. What secrets you must know...

texts.zh:
你们的灵能光环是通过与虚境的调和度来显化的。它影响着周遭的世界，充满了意图。在对话的过程中，我们的巫会已经感知到你们的意图：其中带着贪婪之色。

你们光环的投射目前还很局限。你们应该可以获得虚境中的某一位实体的契约提案，这一理解将会使你们豁然开朗。
texts.en:
Your Psionic Aura is your attunement to the Shroud made manifest. It affects all around you, and is filled with intent. Our coven senses the manner of yours as we speak: a ravenous texture.

The projection of your aura is currently quite limited. Should an entity from within the Shroud offer you the forging of a Covenant, this understanding will clarify in your mind.

texts.zh:
你们的灵能光环是通过与虚境的调和度来显化的。它影响着周遭的世界，充满了意图。在对话的过程中，我们的巫会已经感知到你们的意图：其中带着聪慧之色。

你们光环的投射目前还很局限。你们应该可以获得虚境中的某一位实体的契约提案，这一理解将会使你们豁然开朗。
texts.en:
Your Psionic Aura is your attunement to the Shroud made manifest. It affects all around you, and is filled with intent. Our coven senses the manner of yours as we speak: a clever texture.

The projection of your aura is currently quite limited. Should an entity from within the Shroud offer you the forging of a Covenant, this understanding will clarify in your mind.

texts.zh: 你们光环的投射目前还很局限。你们应该可以获得虚境中的某一位实体的契约提案，这一理解将会使你们豁然开朗。
texts.en: The projection of your aura is currently quite limited. Should an entity from within the Shroud offer you the forging of a Covenant, this understanding will clarify in your mind.

texts.zh: 将虚境显化到物理世界的方法是需要严守的秘密，这一点连我们也无可指教。要释放灵能光环需要自己深入许多灵域。与最喜欢的实体调和，这项知识就会让你豁然开朗。
texts.en: The capability to manifest the Shroud in the physical realm is a closely guarded secret, and one that even we cannot teach. To unleash one's Psionic Aura requires a personal journey into its many domains. Attune more heavily to a favored entity, and this knowledge will clarify in your mind.

texts.zh:
灵能光环的扩增需要极高程度的专注来维持。

我们愿意在此事上提供帮助，但需要提供一些材料助力冥想。
texts.en:
The amplification of Psionic Auras requires great levels of concentration to maintain.

We are willing to assist you in this matter, but will require the contribution of materials to fuel our meditation.

label.zh: 算了。
我们可以用一些泽珞来支持这项行动。
label.en: We can support this endeavor with Zro.

label.zh: 我我们可以用一些星界丝缕来支持这项行动。
label.en: We can support this endeavor with Astral Threads.

label.zh: 再会了。

notes.zh: 审阅注：支付后回到“虚境掌控”子菜单，并在10年后询问是否续约（shroud.5327）。
notes.en: Review note: after paying, the Shroud-mastery submenu re-opens, and a renewal request follows 10 years later (shroud.5327).

texts.zh:
我们灵能使关于扩增你们灵能光环强度的协议已经到期。

为了继续保持冥想，我们需要更多的资源。是否乐意成交？
texts.en:
Our telepaths have reached the end of our agreement to amplify the strength of your Psionic Aura.

In order for us to continue our meditations, we will require further resources. Is this within your interests?

label.zh: 我们将会提供泽珞。
我们将会提供星界丝缕。
现在还不是时候。

texts.zh:
如你们所知，在你们的周围显化你们自己的灵能光环相当容易。但要把光环投射到其他地方，可就完全不是一回事了。

我们知道一种方法……

先进科技和灵能之间的相似之处比人们想象的要多。这也许说明了某种更根本的事实。无论如何，我们知道一种可以传导你们意志的装置。只要与其频率调谐之后，就能把它用作一个补充心智，跨越极远的距离。

我们的这种设计完全可以安装在任何一座适用的恒星基地上。你们对这感兴趣吗？
texts.en:
As you know, manifesting your Psionic Aura in your immediate surroundings is quite easily done. To project one's aura somewhere else, however, is another matter entirely.

We know of a way...

There are more similarities between advanced technology and psionics than one would think. Perhaps this speaks to a greater fundamental truth. In any case, we know of a device that can serve as a conduit for your will. Once you become attuned to its frequencies, it will act as a supplementary mind even across great distances.

Our designs are fully capable of being installed in any suitable starbase. Does such a machine interest you?

label.zh: 算了。
我们可以提供泽珞
我们可以提供星界丝缕。
再会了。

texts.zh:
啊哈，一个重要的问题——和前人所问相比，深刻程度可谓不相上下。这么一个问题有不菲的价格，不过我们可以回答。

然而，要知道：虚境允许我们感知尚未发生的事件，而这些知识将帮助指导你们的道路。但任何单一的事件都不足以撼动星系的运转。

如果你有意达成这笔交易，那么相比于拓展抱负，你应该去做更充分的准备。但是，哦，哪怕是对顷刻将至之事的最细微一瞥，都可能建立起什么样的宏伟计划啊……
texts.en:
Ah, a momentous query - no less poignant for being asked by so many before you. Such a question carries a heavy price, but we can provide answers.

Know this, however: the Shroud allows us to perceive events which have not yet come to pass, and this knowledge shall help guide your course. But it is beyond the power of any one event to alter the turning of the galaxy.

If you would strike this bargain, know that your aspirations should extend no further than to be better prepared. But oh, what grand designs may be built upon even the merest glimpse at what is to come...

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
我们将支付代价。
我们同时只能经历一回预知。
label.en: We may only experience one Divination at a time.

label.zh: 再会了。

texts.zh: 掌控虚境是一次长达10000次生死的旅途；哪怕是我们最天赋异禀的导师也只敢声称自己对虚境的神秘有一些片面的了解。即使如此，他们的智慧也是无价之宝。如果你有所求，我们可以排遣一名导师为你指点迷津。
texts.en: Mastery of the Shroud is a journey of 10,000 lifetimes; even our most gifted teachers can claim only partial knowledge of its mysteries. Nevertheless, their wisdom is invaluable. Should you wish it, we will dispatch one to guide your course.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
我们希望学习。

tooltips.zh: 我们将雇佣一位具有虚境行者导师特质的等级5行政官。
tooltips.en: We will hire a Level 5 Official with the Shroudwalker Teacher Trait.

tooltips.zh:
允许解锁内阁席位：
    虚境行者导师
        每技能等级的£empire£ 帝国效果：
            灵能理论研究选项的概率：+5%
            每月凝聚力+1%
            潜入虚境花费：-2%

可选：
    £official£行政官

要求：
    领袖拥有虚境行者导师特质
tooltips.en:
Allows the unlocking of Council Position:
    Shroudwalker Teacher
        £empire£ Empire Effects per Skill Level:
            Chance for Psionics Research Options: +5%
            Monthly Unity +1%
            Shroud Delve Cost: -2%

Available for:
    £official£ Official

Requirements:
    Leader has the Shroudwalker Teacher Trait.

label.zh: 若日后攻击虚境行者，导师将离去
label.en: If we later attack the Shroudwalkers, the teacher leaves

label.zh: 我们已经为虚境行者导师的效力付了钱。
label.en: We have already purchased the services of a Shroudwalker Teacher.

label.zh: 再会了。

texts.zh: 学海无涯苦作舟：这便是最高级的智慧。我们会给你送去一名导师。好好学习，你必将有所收获。
texts.en: To know that there is always more to know: this is the highest wisdom. A teacher will be sent to you. Learn well, and you will surely reap the rewards.

texts.zh: 对于我们来说有句俗话：‘秘密在梦中翩翩起舞。’对于虚境来说，没有哪个堡垒是不可突破的，没有什么密码是破解不了的。通过我们的冥想，其他人坚信深藏不露的东西会乖乖呈现在我们面前。你有兴趣了解你身边的人在密谋些什么吗？去了解他们的设想，就好像那设想就是你的东西一样？如果你有所求，我们会分享自己的见解。怎么利用这些就是你自己的事了。
texts.en: A saying is known to us: 'Secrets dance in dreams.' To the Shroud, no vault is impenetrable, no code unbreakable. In our meditations, what others believe hidden is often laid bare. Would it interest you to learn what your peers are plotting? To know their designs as if they were your own? Should you wish it, we will share our insights. How you make use of them is up to you.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
[spynetwork_country_1.GetName]
[spynetwork_country_2.GetName]
[spynetwork_country_3.GetName]
[spynetwork_country_4.GetName]
[spynetwork_country_5.GetName]
[spynetwork_country_6.GetName]
再会了。

texts.zh: [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]会凝视虚境，以期获得对[Target.GetName]的内部运作具有指导意义的见解。
texts.en: The [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] will peer into the Shroud in hopes of gaining insight into the inner workings of the [Target.GetName].

sections.zh: 我们对虚境的掌控加速了这个进程，允许我们协助[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的任务。
sections.en: Our mastery of the Shroud hastens the process and allows us to assist the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName] with their task.

label.zh: 洞见完成：策反一名线人（权重40/100）
洞见完成：间谍网络提升（权重25/100）
洞见完成：获得情报（权重25/100）
洞见完成：一无所获（权重10/100）

texts.zh: 据说，在虚境内每一个心灵都会投下自己的影子。通过我们的冥想，某个特定心灵的踟蹰不定在我们面前展露无遗，此人倍受信赖，但其忠诚心却不如看上去的那番坚定。备份已经交给你了。毫无疑问这个人将会成为一名心甘情愿的线人。
texts.en: It is said that within the Shroud every mind casts its shadow. During our meditations, the wavering of a certain mind was laid bare to us, a trusted voice whose loyalty is not as steadfast as it appears. Their duplicity is your gain. No doubt they will prove a willing asset.

label.zh: 真是有趣。

texts.zh: 在你的麾下有许多位身怀绝技的特工，但每一位都困于自身的限制。任何一双眼睛都不能看到自己。但虚境却没有这样的限制；我们的冥想能够揭示许多事情。如果你希望自己的秘密行动能够马到成功，那么你最好是多多聆听我们的建议。
texts.en: You have many skilled agents in your employ, but each is bound by their own limitations. An eye cannot perceive itself. The Shroud knows no such boundaries; our meditations have revealed much. If your clandestine operations are to thrive, you would do well to heed our advice.

label.zh: 真是有趣。

texts.zh: 凡世间的国度并不如其看上去那么坚固。那些居住在里面的人也是这样。你身边人的秘密都展现在了我们面前。我们了解到的事情现在都交给你了。
texts.en: The corporeal realm is not as solid as it appears. So it is with those who dwell within. The secrets of your peers have been revealed to us. What we have learned is now yours.

label.zh: 真是有趣。

texts.zh: 我们有句老话：‘任何事情都有可能发生；这也包括无事发生这件事。’很不幸，我们的冥想没能获得任何见解。
texts.en: A saying is known to us: 'Everything that can happen will; even nothing.' Unfortunately, our meditations have failed to produce any insight.

label.zh: 那真是……令人失望。

texts.zh: 虚境在波动；它的帷幕变得轻薄。我们将从冥想中退出来。我们窥得的所有见解都会对你公开。
texts.en: The Shroud wavers; its veil grows thin. We will now retire to our meditations. Whatever insights we glean will be made known to you.

texts.zh:
星系十分黑暗，危险无处不在。为了点亮朝圣者的路途，我们提供虚境信标。一旦在你的某个恒星基地上面安装这个，它的光芒可以穿透一切；哪怕是某些人称之为现实的缥缈薄暮。它延伸出来的网道可以穿过虚境，为凡间的舰船跨越巨大的时空前往遥远的距离提供了一种手段。

要谨慎地选择你的信标的位置——虚境隧道一旦生成，就不能被移除，也没有可能再召唤出另一个信标。

你要将以下的话语牢记在心：虚境隧道不是普通的道路，就算是我们也无法预测使用这种手段会有什么后果。
texts.en:
The galaxy is dark, and full of dangers. To illumine the path of wayward pilgrims we offer the Shroud Beacon. Once installed on one of your starbases, its light pierces all; even that thin veil some call reality. The Tunnel it spawns offers a bypass through the Shroud, and a means for corporeal vessels to traverse vast distances through space and time.

Choose the location of your Beacon carefully - once established, a Shroud Tunnel cannot be moved, and no secondary Beacon can call another forth.

You would do well to heed these words: a Shroud Tunnel is no ordinary road, and not even we can foretell all the consequences of such a journey.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
我们想要一个虚境信标。
label.en: We would like a Shroud Beacon.

tooltips.zh: 允许在己方某个恒星基地建造一个虚境信标。一旦完工，一个虚境隧道会在恒星系中生成，并提供一个通往[shroudwalker_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系的双向隧道。我们只能生成一个虚境隧道；因此请谨慎选择恒星系的位置。
tooltips.en: Permits building a Shroud Beacon on one of our Starbases. Once built, it will spawn a Shroud Tunnel, providing passage to and from the [shroudwalker_enclave_system.GetName] system. Only one Tunnel can be spawned - choose its location carefully.

label.zh: 在恒星基地建成虚境信标后
label.en: Once the Shroud Beacon is built on a starbase

label.zh: 我们付不起。
再会了。

texts.zh: 一阵低语传达至我们的意识：虚境的道路缥缈不定，变换万千。愿这个信标点亮你前行的道路。
texts.en: A saying is known to us: the paths of the Shroud are strange and winding. May this Beacon light your way forward.

texts.zh: 我们对泽珞特别感兴趣。我们可以教你开采和储存的方法，但前提是你同意把你的产品永久地分成给我们。
texts.en: Zro is of particular interest to us. We could teach you the ways of harvesting and storing it, but only if you agree to give us a share of your production. In perpetuity.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
你们会拿到分成的。教教我们。
label.en: You'll get your share. Teach us.

label.zh: 再会了。

texts.zh: 泽珞是一种奇妙而又可悲的物质，有很多用途，但绝不能轻易使用，因为它是一个上古物种最后的遗产。开采了就要好好珍惜，也别忘了回报我们。
texts.en: Zro is a wonderful yet tragic substance. It has many applications, but should never be used lightly, for it is the last legacy of a most venerable species. Harvest it, treasure it, and don't forget to pay us what you owe.

texts.zh:
确实，我们知道这些穿行于位面之间的人。这是一个危险的议案，各个物理世界联系在一起的方式连我们也不理解。

然而，我们愿意为你们打开一条道路。必须负责任以负责任的态度进行这种时空去稳化，所以我们如此提议。
texts.en:
Indeed, we are aware of those who walk between planes. This is a dangerous proposition, as the physical realms are connected in ways even we do not understand.

However, we are willing to open one path for you. Such a destabilization of time and space must be done responsibly, so our offer stands at that.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
打开道路。
我们没有恒星系可供裂分创造新裂隙。
label.en: There are no valid systems in which we can split open a new Rift.

label.zh: 打开道路。
我们没有恒星系可供裂分创造新裂隙。
label.en: There are no valid systems in which we can split open a new Rift.

label.zh: 再会了。

texts.zh:
你们问这个问题我们一点也不惊讶。我们已经在这里感知到你们的兴趣了，也很乐意帮助你们的心智扩张。

但我们警告你们：等你们的双眼真的睁开之时，就有东西再也无法视而不见了。你们正在追寻的正是一条通向虚境的路。

我们不轻易做这笔交易，相信你们做好准备的时候会来告诉我们的。
texts.en:
It is no surprise to us that you ask this question. We have sensed your interest in this area, and are pleased to be in a position to assist you in expanding your mind.

We warn you: Once your eyes become truly opened, there are things that cannot be unseen. The path you are inviting is a path to the Shroud.

We do not make this offer lightly. We trust that you will let us know when you are ready.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。
我们会付账的。
再会了。

texts.zh:
一段非常有趣的故事。你说的是“面纱旅人”，对吧？在某些方面，这个虚境确实和我们自己的很像，但是对于不了解的人来说，这些差异可能很微妙；其实它们很深刻，是一种扭曲的反射，来自一个与我们不尽相同的宇宙。

虚境的表面有很多裂痕。那些深入其奥秘的人最终可能并不会回到他们本来的宇宙。
texts.en:
A most interesting story. Veilfarer, you said? In some ways, this coven does resemble our own, but while these differences may appear subtle to the uninitiated, they are profound: a distorted reflection, from an universe not quite like our own.

The Shroud has many tears on its surface. Those who enter its mysteries may not always end up in the same universe from whence they started.

label.zh: 跨越维度的灵能旅行……令人神往。

tooltips.zh: 灵能跃迁引擎科技出现是正常几率的1.5倍。
tooltips.en: Psi Jump Drive technology now appears at 1.5 times the normal rate.

notes.zh: 审阅注：仅当曾在首次接触事件fircon.1212中听过“面纱旅人”的故事（first_contact_dlc_events.txt:711设置标记）且尚未揭秘时出现；打捞者城邦菜单也有同一询问，同样转到本窗口。
notes.en: Review note: only offered after hearing the Veilfarer's story in first-contact event fircon.1212 (flag set at first_contact_dlc_events.txt:711) and before the secret is revealed; the Salvager menu offers the same question and opens this same window.

texts.zh:
各位来客，我们在此向你问好。

我们早已知晓你们的存在，但由于担心自己会给你们的未来带来不恰当的影响，我们一直躲在幕后。不过，我们现在是时候从垂帘后走出来了，对于外行人而言，虚境的运作机制可能显得古怪且令人不安。正是处于这个原因，我们决定为你们提供指导。如果你们同意的话，我们愿意成为你们的引路人。

去探索吧，不过在我们下次重逢之前，记得注意安全。
texts.en:
Fellow travelers, we greet you.

Your presence on the galactic stage has long been known to us, but until now, afraid we might unduly influence your destiny, we have held back. However, the time has come to lift the veil; the ways of the Shroud may seem strange and unnerving to the uninitiated, and it is for this reason that we offer guidance. Realize that you have someone willing to be your teacher, if you so wish.

Wander safely, until our next encounter.

label.zh: 有趣……

notes.zh: 审阅注：采纳“大觉醒”传统（灵能或虚境版本）后360–1080天，若尚未联络虚境行者，则由其主动问候并建立通讯（01_psionics.txt:112；01_psionics_shroud.txt:166/201）。
notes.en: Review note: 360-1080 days after adopting the 'Great Awakening' tradition (psionic or Shroud version), the Shroudwalkers greet an empire they have no contact with yet and establish communications (01_psionics.txt:112; 01_psionics_shroud.txt:166/201).

summary.text:
# 虚境行者城邦 / Shroudwalker Enclave

- 分类 Category：巨兽与城邦 · DLC：霸主 Overlord（部分服务需“虚境”“星界”相关内容）
- 来源 Sources：events/overlord_enclaves_events.txt:6756（enclave.400）, :6795（enclave.404）, :6820（enclave.405 菜单 menu）, :7226–7485（410–425）, :12711（7000）, :12810–13318（7050–7255）; events/shroud_events.txt:17388–18347（shroud.5300–5355）; common/situations/01_overlord_situations.txt:226; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:742, :4960–4966; common/special_projects/04_projects_shroud.txt:899
- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12（C6）

## 如何开始 How it starts
可重复使用的联络菜单 enclave.405：首次接触完成或“通讯已建立”后经 enclave.404 打开，之后每次外交联络经 enclave.400 打开。另有“引见”（enclave.7000）：采纳“大觉醒”传统（灵能或虚境版本）360–1080天后，若尚未联络，虚境行者主动问候并建立通讯。
Repeatable menu enclave.405, opened via enclave.404 after first contact and via enclave.400 on later contacts. Introduction 7000: 360–1080 days after adopting certain psionic traditions, the Shroudwalkers greet an empire they have not met.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline（菜单与服务 Menu and services）
大多数服务以“考虑别的事”返回菜单（↺）。Most services return to the menu.
- 寻求虚境掌控 Mastery of the Shroud（需虚境DLC、已突破虚境、已与一位庇护者完成接触）：打开一个子菜单（shroud.5300，编译器将其折叠），含六项：
  - 与其他虚境存在交流（5305）：支付泽珞或星界丝线 → 随机与一位尚未接触的虚境庇护者建立初次接触（各庇护者的初次接触为独立故事，跨故事链接）。
  - 加深庇护者调谐（5310）、灵能光环说明（5320）。
